biggest_catch: Slow and mail-in: you get the $100 split into two $50 prepaid cards — one coupon mailed within 90 days after your 1st month of service, the other within 90 days after your 6th month, then 4-6 weeks of processing. You're committing to ~7 months of service for the full $100.
catches: Mail-in process: top $50 coupon must be mailed within 90 days after the 1st month of service; bottom $50 coupon within 90 days after the 6th month of service.
Each mailing must include a copy of a utility bill showing Verde Energy USA as your provider.
You must be an active Verde customer on a qualifying plan and remain in good standing (not pending cancellation) at the time of reward processing.
Limit one $100 Rebate Reward Form per account; allow 4-6 weeks for processing.
Separate gas rebate exists ($50 for natural gas plans) — this route is the $100 electricity rebate.
Rebate cards are Pathward-issued Visa prepaid cards, US only, 6-month validity; may not be transferred or redeemed for cash.
Plan-rate/ETF risk: signing up for an energy plan can carry early-termination fees — check your plan's terms before switching.
Savings on planned energy spending — the rebate offsets your electricity costs, not income.
